svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V3 · LIGHT & CALM CUT

g.text: Why the Panama Canal ran short of water
V3 · SHOT 13 — HERO: THE PRODUCTION PANEL

svg.text: Split screen. Left, light: the project card. Right, brew-dark: a monospace system
panel ticking down the whole job: topic received → researching 14 sources → verified
source found → script → voice → edit assembled. A green arrow links card to panel.
Dark panel wipes in from the right (shape transition, hard vertical edge). Rows land
one per beat over a 6 s hold (the reference's longest beat); progress bars fill in
real time. Ref: Numtera's "Connected to your infrastructure" knowledge-lock moment.
"We research it, write it, voice it, and cut it."
Beat drops in; a mechanical tick per row.
Panel completes; the light half wipes back over.

g.text: V3 · SHOT 14 — A PERSON REVIEWS IT { FRAME BY FRAME }

svg.text: A person reviews it { frame by frame }
White stage. "A person reviews it { frame by frame }" with the braces and phrase in
Sentence fades in; the braced phrase types on last. Ref: "Agent Approves it as {
"Then a person reviews it, frame by frame."
Words fall away; "{ frame by frame }" stretches into a green bar.

g.text: V3 · SHOT 15 — SHAPE MORPH: PHRASE → BAR

svg.text: The braced phrase stretches into a full-width green bar reading "reviewing…" with a
Shape transition: the text block's bounds morph into a 1700 px bar (e-in-out, 500 ms)
and the text cross-dissolves to mono "reviewing…". Ref: "{ learning }" → "learning…"
Rising tone that tracks the bar.
The bar shrinks into the header of a review card.

g.text: V3 · SHOT 16 — REVIEW CARD + SCAN LINE

svg.text: The bar is now the green header of a small review card: the Rose Freedman frame, a
scan line sweeping across it, and a log underneath: "Named people match the narration
✓ / Places dated and sourced ✓ / Numbers legible on pause ✓".
Scan line passes top → bottom twice (teal glow). Log lines type on in mono. Ref: the
"Every name, every place, every number. Checked."
